comments_data.body: Thanks @lilitkarapetyan - could you explain how the changes work in the two code blocks please?

There are still more icon downloads than I'd like, but I guess we're using the icons in different locations - so they get downloaded from different locations.

In the future we should probably create a hidden "icon cache" component. JS would request an icon from the cache, and the cache would only retrieve it if it hadn't been retrieved already (cached).

![Screenshot (116)](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/20753599/182893999-eaa0b399-7bf7-4def-bfb9-e164c5c3d593.png)
Hello Ian, in both code blocks we use <AssetIcon_ /> component to show svg (pictures). In case of information marker icons fetch works 2 times, as because we have 2 svg there.

issues.title: Not cache-ing ASSET icons
issues.body:
Each time we click on an asset marker, SERGE fetches the icon from the Internet.

Note: we don't do this for information markers.

![screencast](https://i.gyazo.com/a1d985ebb68f14c79d1e200d325a70ef.gif)
